fields.label: Site logo
fields.name: site_logo
fields.instructions: Used in the header. If empty, the WordPress Customizer logo, then a built-in logo, is used. Tip: set the browser Site Icon (favicon) under Appearance → Customize → Site Identity.

fields.label: Alternate logo (light version)
fields.name: alt_logo
fields.instructions: Optional version for dark backgrounds, used in the footer.

fields.label: Market name
fields.name: market_name
fields.instructions: Defaults to the Site Title.

fields.label: Address
fields.name: address
fields.instructions: Street, town, postcode — one line each.

fields.label: Market days (short)
fields.name: market_days
fields.instructions: e.g. "Every Sunday, 9 AM – 1 PM". Shown in highlights and the footer.

fields.label: Opening hours
fields.name: opening_hours
fields.instructions: Used in the footer and for structured data.

fields.label: WhatsApp number
fields.name: whatsapp_number
fields.instructions: International format, e.g. +44 7700 900123. Used for the wa.me link. Leave empty to hide WhatsApp.

fields.label: Facebook URL
fields.name: facebook_url
fields.instructions: Leave empty until the profile exists; the icon then shows a “Coming soon” message.

fields.label: Header button
fields.name: header_cta
fields.instructions: e.g. "Become a Vendor". Leave empty to hide.

fields.label: Newsletter description
fields.name: newsletter_description
fields.default_value: Get market updates, special events, and seasonal highlights delivered to your inbox.

fields.label: Newsletter consent text
fields.name: newsletter_consent
fields.instructions: Shown beside the consent checkbox. {market} is replaced by the market name.
fields.default_value: I agree to receive email updates from {market}. I can unsubscribe at any time.

fields.label: Cookie policy page
fields.name: cookie_policy_page
fields.instructions: Linked from the cookie banner.

fields.label: Copyright text
fields.name: copyright_text
fields.instructions: Use {year} for the current year. Defaults to "© {year} Site title".

fields.label: About
fields.message: Uses the telephone, email and WhatsApp numbers from the General tab. A method is hidden automatically when its detail is empty.

fields.label: Enable cookie consent banner
fields.name: ui_cookie_banner
fields.instructions: Shows the consent banner and the footer "Cookie settings" link. Keep on unless you use another consent tool.

fields.label: About global FAQs
fields.message: Used as the default FAQ on the Vendors and Events pages. A single vendor or event can override it with its own FAQ. The About Us and Become a Vendor FAQs are edited on those pages.

fields.label: Global Vendors FAQ
fields.name: faq_vendors_items
fields.instructions: Add, remove or drag to reorder. Rows with an empty question or answer are ignored. Only questions you actually answer on the page are published (and added to structured data).

fields.label: Global Events FAQ
fields.name: faq_events_items
fields.instructions: Add, remove or drag to reorder. Rows with an empty question or answer are ignored. Only questions you actually answer on the page are published (and added to structured data).

fields.label: Applications are open
fields.name: apps_enabled
fields.instructions: Turn off to close the form (the page stays visible).

fields.label: Notification email
fields.name: apps_notify_email
fields.instructions: Receives a short alert for each new application (no applicant details). Defaults to the site admin email.

fields.label: Email an acknowledgement to the applicant
fields.name: apps_ack_applicant
fields.instructions: Sends a generic "we received your application" message.

fields.label: Application deadline (optional)
fields.name: apps_deadline
fields.instructions: After this date the form closes. Leave empty for year-round applications.

fields.label: Charge an application fee
fields.name: apps_fee_enabled
fields.instructions: Only enable if a fee really applies. No payment is collected on the site: applicants just acknowledge the fee.

fields.label: Fee description
fields.name: apps_fee_description
fields.instructions: e.g. "one-time administration fee, payable if approved"

fields.label: Booth / stall requirements
fields.name: apps_booth
fields.instructions: Shown on the Become a Vendor page. Only state real requirements.

fields.label: Application instructions
fields.name: apps_instructions
fields.instructions: Short text above the form.

fields.label: Success message
fields.name: apps_success
fields.default_value: Thank you for applying! Your application has been received. Our team will review your information and contact you about the next steps.

fields.label: Extra terms (optional)
fields.name: apps_terms
fields.instructions: Shown above the consent checkbox.
